import { asc } from "drizzle-orm";
import type { ListNotesStore } from "{{scope}}/notebook/application";
import type { Note } from "{{scope}}/notebook/domain";
import type { DrizzleDatabase } from "../drizzle-database.ts";
import { notes } from "../schema/notes.ts";
import { toNote } from "./note.mapper.ts";

export class DrizzleListNotesStore implements ListNotesStore {
  constructor(private readonly db: DrizzleDatabase) {}

  async findAll(): Promise<Note[]> {
    const rows = await this.db.select({ id: notes.id, text: notes.text }).from(notes).orderBy(asc(notes.position));
    return rows.map(toNote);
  }
}
